Pattern2 expands %s to Java ASCII whitespace plus NBSP, including VT. However RegexLeaf#getFoxSignature assigns a required whitespace mask to [%s]+; RegexConcat#match rejects a line missing that mask before executing the regex. FoxSignature initializes SPACE/TAB/CR/LF/FF and NBSP but omits VT. Thus an only-VT-separated command can be Java-invalid although its regex alone would accept. Preserved VT deactivate/destroy/hide/resume counterexamples expose this pre-existing Rust/Java command-pipeline discrepancy; raw regex class equality does not prove whole-command equivalence.
